draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.27, the 63rd-best grade among 259 2023 draftees and 10th of 36 at CB. He went 51st overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: A.J. Bouye. Testing standouts: 10-yard split (87th percentile), broad jump (94th percentile). College production: 5 passes defended in 2022, 26th of 36 CBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Current status: free agent. Last NFL action came in 2024. 21 career games and 0 starts over 2 completed seasons. Career-best season: 1 AV in 2023. Weak spots: approximate value 0 (2nd percentile). Played 6 of 17 games in 2024.
